snippet.title: Makab Horazon: Ang Stalker Trailer (Filipino Horror Game Jam 2026)
snippet.description:
Jam Link: https://itch.io/jam/filipino-horror-game-jam-2026
Game Link: https://mim-house.itch.io/makab-horazon-ang-stalker

Makab Horazon: Ang Stalker is a short game that tests the player's reflexes.

The player must guide the Lady and get her home safely with the use of stalling tactics. The length and difficulty of the game may be adjusted according to the player's preferences.

The game is simple: Move forward and pay attention.

The Stalker follows, so look back at the right time or face the consequence.  The player can also perform a fake call. But, of course, this will only work on the first few tries.

Don't worry, though. The Lady can fight with the help of the player's guidance. She can run, but so can the Stalker. DODGE.

There is a reward for using your resources at the last minute. But when is the last minute? That's for you to find out.

The loop, length and story of this game have been changed to qualify as an entry for the Filipino Horror Game Jam 2026. The full version of this game, which is a part of our bigger project called the Makab Horazon Anthology, may be  a lot different from this current version.
